id: Hebrew: Psalm 1 — Blessedness of Righteousness

event_chain.action: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 2 — Royal Authority

event_chain.action: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed.
Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.
Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 6 — Penitential Lament

event_chain.action: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me, for thou knowest I am feeble.
My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
Return, O LORD, return unto me, according to thy great mercy, and pardon my sin.
O LORD, let thy mercy be upon me, as thou wert wont to do unto all those that love thee.
I will offer unto thee my whole heart, and my whole soul, and my whole life.
Bless the LORD, O my soul; let all that is within me bless his holy name.
O LORD, let my prayer be heard; and let my cry come unto thee.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 8 — Praise of the LORD

event_chain.action: O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hath set thy glory above the heavens!
Thou art the fountain of wisdom; thou hast made all things; thou art the source of all good.
Thy word is truth; thy law is perfection; thy way is the way of righteousness.
Blessed are those that walk in thy ways; they shall prosper in all that they do.
For thou art the God of all nations; the God of all peoples; the God of all creatures.
Hear us, O LORD, when we call upon thee; answer our prayer, and grant us thy blessing.
Let the whole earth rejoice in thy name; let all the nations sing thy praise.
For thou art mighty, and thy kingdom shall endure for ever and ever.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 18 — Royal Thanksgiving

event_chain.action: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
My mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips; for thou hast saved me from my enemies.
I will offer unto thee my whole heart, and my whole soul, and my whole life.
Thou art my God; I will bless thee for ever and ever.
For thou hast delivered me from the hand of mine adversaries; thou hast protected me from evil.
I will sing of thy mercy and thy grace; I will proclaim thy righteousness to all the world.
O LORD, let my prayer be heard; and let my cry come unto thee.
For thou art my strength; and in thee do I put my trust.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 20 — Petition for the King

event_chain.action: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Israel protect thee.
O LORD, be thou a light unto my path; be thou a shield against mine enemies.
For there are many that lie in wait for me; they seek to do me harm.
Let not mine enemies prevail against me; but let thy hand be stretched forth to save me.
Blessed be the LORD; for he hath not forsaken me in my time of need.
The LORD is my refuge; in him do I put my trust; he will not let me fall.
O LORD, grant me peace; let my enemies be confounded; and let my friends rejoice.
For thou art the king of kings; and thy kingdom shall endure for ever.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 23 — The Shepherd Psalm

event_chain.action: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness.
The LORD is my keeper; and he shall never let me fall.
Blessed be the name of the LORD; for he is my guide and my protector.
Serve the LORD with all thy heart; follow him in all his ways.
For he is the good shepherd; and he careth for his flock.
Let all the earth bless the LORD; for he is the fountain of all goodness.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 29 — Praise and Thanksgiving

event_chain.action: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Offer unto him the sacrifice of praise; let your voices be lifted up in song.
For he is the God of all gods; he is the king of all kings.
Blessed be the LORD; for he hath given us victory over our enemies.
Let the whole earth rejoice; for the LORD is mighty and his kingdom is great.
I will offer up my heart in thanksgiving; I will sing praises unto his holy name.
O LORD, let thy blessing be upon us; let thy favor be with us always.
For thou art the source of all good; and all good things come from thee.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 32 — Confession and Forgiveness

event_chain.action: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered by the mercy of the LORD.
O LORD, let thy mercy be upon me; forgive me my transgressions.
For I have sinned; and I am not worthy of thy grace.
But thou, O LORD, art full of compassion; thy mercy is without end.
I will offer unto thee the sacrifice of a contrite heart; I will humble myself before thee.
Let the LORD be praised; for he is merciful and just.
O LORD, grant me thy forgiveness; let me be cleansed of my sins.
For thou art the God of all mercy; and thy love is without bound.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 33 — Joyful Praise

event_chain.action: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the just.
Sing unto the LORD a new song; let the whole earth resound with his glory.
For the LORD is good; and his mercy is upon all who trust in him.
Blessed be the LORD; for he hath given us life and breath.
Let the heavens rejoice; let the earth be glad; for the LORD is great.
I will praise the LORD with all my heart; I will exalt him with my whole soul.
O LORD, let thy blessing be upon all who love thee; let thy grace be upon all who serve thee.
For thou art the joy of all creation; and thy praises shall never cease.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 34 — Exaltation of God

event_chain.action: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
He is the creator of all things; he hath made the heavens and the earth.
His glory is above the heavens; his power is beyond measure.
Blessed be the name of the LORD; for he is the fountain of all wisdom.
I will offer unto him the sacrifice of praise; I will sing his glory all the day long.
For he is the God of all nations; he is the king of all the earth.
Let the whole earth praise him; let all creation adore his name.
For his glory is eternal; and his kingdom shall never end.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 38 — Penitential Cry

event_chain.action: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot anger.
For I am weak and sinful; and I have strayed from thy ways.
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am sore afflicted.
Heal me, O LORD; for thou knowest my pain.
Let the LORD be praised; for he is full of compassion.
I will humble myself before thee; I will offer the sacrifice of a broken heart.
O LORD, let thy mercy be upon me; and let my prayer be heard.
For thou art the God of all mercy; and thy forgiveness is without end.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 40 — Petition and Trust

event_chain.action: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
O LORD, let my prayer be heard; let my cry come unto thee.
For I am in distress; and my enemies are all around me.
Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies; protect me from their wickedness.
Blessed be the LORD; for he is my shield and my protector.
The LORD is my refuge; in him do I put my trust.
For thou art my God; and I will praise thee for ever and ever.
O LORD, grant me peace; and let all who love thee rejoice in thy name.

id: Hebrew: Psalm 51 — Penitential Prayer (Miserere)

event_chain.action: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
For I have sinned against thee; and my transgressions are many.
Forgive me, O LORD; for I am penitent; let thy mercy prevail.
I will offer unto thee the sacrifice of a broken heart; I will humble myself before thee.
Blessed be the LORD; for he is merciful beyond measure.
O LORD, let thy grace be upon me; let thy mercy cleanse my soul.
For thou art the God of compassion; and thy forgiveness is without bound.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 1, Hymn I — Agni (Praise and Invocation)

event_chain.action: I laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The Hotar, lavishest of wealth.
Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers: He shall bring hitherward the Gods.
Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.
Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.
May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.
Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.
Agni, come to our sacrifice; be our messenger to the Gods; grant us wealth and renown.
Let Agni, the wise priest, accept our offering and bring the Gods to our feast.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 1, Hymn XXIV — Varuna (Petition and Praise)

event_chain.action: Sing forth to Varuna, the Lord of righteousness, who created the paths of the sun.
He who knows the path of the birds flying through the air, he who knows the ships on the ocean.
Varuna is the keeper of cosmic order; he sees all things, the hidden and the manifest.
If we have sinned against the laws of Varuna, O God, let us not suffer thy punishment.
Release us from the bonds of sin; let us not be caught in thy noose.
We offer our hymns and oblations to Varuna; accept them, O Lord of truth.
May Varuna, the wise and all-seeing, grant us his blessing and protection.
O Varuna, may we dwell in thy mercy; may the noose of sin be loosened from us.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 1, Hymn XCI — Soma (Sacrificial Praise)

event_chain.action: The Soma juices have been pressed; the sacred drink is prepared for the Gods.
Soma, the king of plants, the lord of immortality, flows pure and bright.
He who drinks the Soma is filled with heroic strength and wisdom.
We offer the Soma to Indra; let him drink and be pleased with our devotion.
Soma is the purifier, the healer, the giver of life and abundance.
May Soma, the pavamana, cleanse us of our impurities and grant us long life.
O Soma, flow for Indra; let the drops of immortality bring the Gods to our sacrifice.
The Soma streams flow like rivers; they bring joy to the hearts of the worshippers.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 1, Hymn CLXIV — Visvedevas (Cosmological Riddles)

event_chain.action: Who here can speak of the creation? Who here can tell of its origin?
The one who is the overseer of this world in the highest heaven—he alone knows.
The cow, the mother of the Rudras, the daughter of the Vasus, the sister of the Adityas.
I ask you, O Gods, the hidden knowledge: what is the one in the form of the many?
The tree of heaven with its roots above and branches below—this is the eternal fig tree.
The seven sages, the seven sacrifices, the seven forms of the one truth.
O Gods, reveal to us the hidden truth; let us know the one who is behind all things.
The one truth, the sages speak of in many ways—Agni, Yama, Matarisvan.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 1, Hymn X — Indra (Praise to Lord of Power)

event_chain.action: The priests have raised thee up on high, O Satakratu, like a banner; they magnify thee with their songs.
Indra, the thunderer, the slayer of Vritra, the giver of victory in battle.
The Soma pressers praise thee; they offer the sacred drink to thee, the mighty one.
Thou hast slain Vritra with thy bolt; thou hast freed the waters for the people.
Let Indra come to our sacrifice; let him drink the Soma and grant us strength.
O Indra, give us wealth and victory; protect us in battle against our enemies.
Thou art the lord of all strength; thou art the mighty one who is invoked by many.
May Indra, the giver of all boons, be pleased with our hymns and grant us his favor.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 3, Hymn I — Agni (Praise to the Fire God)

event_chain.action: Thou, Agni, who wilt have the strong, hast made me the Soma's priest, to worship the Gods.
Agni, the wise, the messenger between worlds, the bearer of oblations to the Gods.
He who worships Agni with faith and devotion shall obtain wealth and prosperity.
We kindle the fire; we offer the oblation; we call upon Agni to bring the Gods.
Agni knows the generations of the Gods; he is the priest who sits at the altar.
May Agni, the lord of the sacrifice, accept our offering and bless us with good fortune.
O Agni, come to our sacrifice; bring the Gods to feast; grant us health and wealth.
We offer the sacred ghee into the flame; may it reach the Gods and please them.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 3, Hymn IV — Indra (Invocation and Praise)

event_chain.action: Come to us, Indra, with thy strong horses; drink the Soma we have prepared for thee.
Indra, the bull among warriors, the lord of the thunderbolt, the slayer of Vritra.
The Soma juices are pressed for thee; the hymns are sung for thy glory.
Smite our enemies, O Indra; give us victory in battle; protect us from harm.
Thou art the giver of wealth and victory; thou art the protector of thy worshippers.
We offer the sacred drink and the hymns of praise; accept them, O lord of power.
Grant us thy protection, O Indra; let us dwell in safety and abundance.
May Indra, the mighty, be pleased with our devotion and bless us with his favor.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 3, Hymn VIII — Indra-Vishnu (Joint Invocation)

event_chain.action: The Soma is pressed for Indra and Vishnu; the sacred drink is offered to the two gods.
Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, and Vishnu, the wide-strider, are invoked together.
May Indra and Vishnu come to our sacrifice; may they accept our oblations with favor.
Grant us wealth and offspring, O Indra and Vishnu; protect us from our enemies.
Vishnu measured the three worlds; Indra conquered the waters and released them.
The two are mighty and worthy of praise; their deeds are renowned in heaven and earth.
We offer the sacred ghee and the pressed Soma; may the gods be pleased with our sacrifice.
May Indra and Vishnu, the lords of strength, bless us with their grace and protection.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 10, Hymn I — Agni (Invocation)

event_chain.action: High hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from the darkness.
Agni, the wise priest, the lord of the sacrifice, kindled by the fire-sticks.
He shines with pure light; he is the messenger between the worlds.
We kindle Agni with the sacred fuel; we offer the oblation into the flame.
Agni, the purifier, the giver of wealth, the destroyer of darkness.
May Agni, who knows all the ways, bring the Gods to our sacrifice.
O Agni, grant us thy protection; let us dwell in the light of thy grace.
The fire rises high; it carries our prayers to the heavens; the Gods are pleased.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 10, Hymn XC — Purusha Sukta (Cosmic Man)

event_chain.action: Purusha has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. He envelops the earth on all sides.
This whole universe is but a quarter of him; three-quarters of him are immortal in heaven.
The Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as the offering; the sacred rite was born.
From that great sacrifice, the ghee, the beasts of the air and forest, the hymns and meters were born.
From that sacrifice, the horses, the cattle, and all creatures with two rows of teeth were born.
From the sacrifice, the Brahman was born; the four social orders were established.
The moon was born from the mind of Purusha; the sun from his eye; Indra and Agni from his mouth.
With the sacrifice, the Gods sacrificed to the sacrifice itself; these were the first sacred ordinances.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 10, Hymn CXXIX — Nasadiya (Creation Hymn)

event_chain.action: Then there was neither Being nor Non-being; there was no air nor sky beyond.
What covered the void? Where was the water? The deep darkness was everywhere.
But there was that One, breathing without breath, by its own power; beyond that, nothing else existed.
Desire arose in the beginning; that was the first seed of the mind—the bond between Being and Non-being.
The sages who searched with wisdom in their hearts found the bond of Being in Non-being.
The ray of light stretched across the void; the seed of creation was planted.
Who knows the secret? Who here can declare whence this creation arose?
The Gods came after creation—who then knows whence it arose? Only the one who watches from the highest heaven knows.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 10, Hymn LXXXV — Wedding of Surya (Bridal Hymn)

event_chain.action: Truth is the foundation that supports the earth; the sun Surya is led to her wedding.
The marriage of Surya to Soma is the prototype of all marriages; the Gods established the rite.
May the bride be blessed with happiness; may she be loved by her husband and bear many sons.
The father gives away his daughter with due ceremony; the priest recites the sacred formulas.
May the newlyweds live in harmony; may their home be filled with joy and abundance.
The offerings are made to Agni; the sacred fire witnesses the union.
May no widowhood befall the bride; may she be protected and cherished.
Surya, the sun's daughter, is the first bride; her wedding is the pattern for all human marriages.

id: Rig Veda: Mandala 10, Hymn CXII — Prayer to Various Gods (General Petition)

event_chain.action: May the Gods protect us; may the waters bring us wealth; may the plants bring us healing.
Agni, the messenger, carries our prayers to the heavens; the Gods hear our call.
We offer the pressed Soma and the sacred hymns; may the Gods be pleased with our devotion.
Grant us strength, O Indra; grant us wisdom, O Varuna; grant us wealth, O the Ashvins.
May our enemies be overcome; may we be victorious in all our battles.
May the Gods, the lords of truth, protect us from harm and grant us long life.
O Gods, let us dwell in your grace; let us be blessed with good fortune.
All the Gods are invoked together; may they accept our offerings and grant us their blessings.
